_comment: Documentation of what the RFC 5424 parser (the oracle) decodes from the REAL committed characters of the §6.5 example lines + the downgraded twin. No spec check uses from:generated — the visual primitives read the parse tree directly — so these keys (all underscore-prefixed) are documentation the replay test asserts against the parser, never injected expectations. PRIVAL = Facility*8 + Severity is the parser's arithmetic; the line is the answer key.
